dedupe_keys.name: ncc telecom service statistics monthly mobile 5g iot and broadband subscriptions data usage and scam call blocking taiwan

description: Taiwan's National Communications Commission publishes its telecom market statistics as separate datasets on the national open data portal. Mobile subscriptions by operator and technology from 2G to 5G run monthly from 2015. Mobile broadband (09 number) users are split into 4G and 5G, postpaid and prepaid. A monthly count of IoT (040) numbers is included. Broadband accounts are given monthly by access type: ADSL, FTTx, cable modem, leased line, mobile and public wifi, and actual mobile broadband users with and without voice. Average monthly mobile data use per subscriber is given by operator, in GB, with totals and user counts. A monthly operating results table covers local telephone lines per 100 people, international outgoing minutes, ISDN users, leased circuits, mobile users and minutes, internet and broadband accounts. A monthly count of international incoming calls blocked as suspected fraud has run since late 2024. Most series were updated in August or September 2026. Coverage: Taiwan, national and by operator. Format and access: CSV, with XLSX, ODS and JSON for most, free under the Open Government Data License. Caveats: operator series break at the 2023 mergers and the 2024 3G shutdown; several older NCC series moved to the Ministry of Digital Affairs and are no longer updated; the NCC file server refused automated requests from here. Simulation uses: demand and traffic growth for capacity planning, 5G uptake by operator, and scam-call volumes as an input for fraud-resilience scenarios. Related records: the NCC base station statistics give the supply side; the OFCA communications open data for Hong Kong and the MCMC facts and figures for Malaysia are comparable regulator series.
name: NCC telecom service statistics: monthly mobile, 5G, IoT and broadband subscriptions, data usage and scam call blocking (Taiwan)
